rationale: Water damage to the policyholder's own basement and contents caused by a burst supply line in the policyholder's own plumbing is classic property damage coverage.
claim_summary: Policyholder Sam Patel (POL-1004) returned from work trip to find basement flooded with approximately two inches of water caused by a burst supply line under upstairs bathroom sink that ran undetected for about two days. Damage includes buckled hardwood flooring, soaked drywall up to one foot high, and ruined stored contents. Estimated damage likely exceeds $25,000; urgent water mitigation and inspection needed.

case_facts.description: approximately two inches of water across entire basement; hardwood floor buckled; drywall soaked up to one foot high; stored boxes ruined
case_facts.cause: burst supply line under upstairs bathroom sink, ran for approximately two days

rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles on back porch overhang) is straightforward property damage covered under homeowners insurance.
claim_summary: Wind damage to back porch roof overhang; four shingles blown off with no water intrusion. Estimated repair cost $400. Low severity, straightforward property damage claim.

case_facts.description: Wind blew off approximately four shingles from roof overhang; no water intrusion
